grain.empty_day: unobserved sale price, not zero price

operations.bounds: lower inclusive, upper exclusive; a maximum exactly on a bin boundary must open the next bin

operations.rule: Select the boundary again using only training days, then predict the omitted day

interpretation: An apparent threshold in store-average prices is not a common SKU price boundary. Candidate cut positions and in-sample differences must not be presented as confirmed price effects.
requirements: Show observation counts and daily variation for each price band
Keep per-SKU results separate from pooled store summaries
Do not equate similar sample means with proof of equivalent sales
Do not extrapolate beyond observed realized prices
Keep exploratory thresholds distinct from causal claims or recommended prices
Use deterministic statistical code; DeepSeek only selects a supported plan
Integrate as a reviewed statistical operation with dependencies before enabling a speech alias
